what: When the text crosses the line 15% from the screen bottom, characters light up one by one in a pale color (.2s · .025s apart), and .05s after all are lit, their own text color is painted in the same order (.1s · .025s apart) — a white wave passes once more behind the gray wave. Once only

options.dur: Duration of one character lighting up (sec), default .2
options.ink: Time for each character to take on its own color (seconds), default .1
options.gap: Pause after turn-on finishes until painting (sec), default .05
options.start: Starts at the line this far up from the bottom of the screen — % or px, default 15%

from.where: shared.js body·price list·business hours text (.sz-txt·.sz-mname·.sz-mprice·.sz-infotext …) — painting twice, gray → white
